NSS SPECIAL CAMP 
Days 1,2&3 
 
 NSS Programme Officer along with few volunteers visited the adopted village 
Venkatapuram, interacted with Panchayat Secretary and took the permission 
to conduct Special Camp from 15.03.2021 to 21.03.2021. 
 
 NSS Programme Officer along with volunteers visited the surroundings of 
Venkatapuram Village, met students and teachers of M.P.P School. 
 
 The next day i.e. 15 th of March, 2021. Dr N Sudhakar Reddy, Principal, S V 
College of Engineering,distributed the books, pens and pencils to the school 
students.  
 
 On 16th of March, 2021.Dr T Chandraiah,NSS,Programme officer create 
awareness on cleanliness of individual and our surroundings to the school 
students. 
 On 17 th of March, 2021 Volunteers interacted with the students of M.P.P 
School and conducted an elocution competition on “Role of students in 
strengthening the society”. Students have shared different ideas to 
strengthen the society through education.

NSS SPECIAL CAMP 
Days 4 & 5 
 NSS P.O. along with the volunteers displayed several videos on basics of 
education and responsibility of a student etc which will connect children and 
contribute to their world. 
  Volunteers addressed the students about food habit and distributed the food. 
 
 
NSS SPECIAL CAMP 
Days 6 & 7 
  NSS P.O. along with the volunteers conducted several physical fitness games 
like lemon and spoon, running race, cricket and musical chairs etc to the 
students to create the positive opinion on the school education. All the 
students were actively participated. 
 Rally on Corona virus was conducted with all the volunteers at venkatapuram 
in association with Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, Tirupati.
